//: Renderer's own settings, read at startup from CB_DIR_PATH/config.json.
//why: Shipping this file is what stops 'Failed to load config. Use default config.' Every value below is the default the renderer already falls back to, so behaviour is unchanged -- what changes is that the file is found, config_refresh() succeeds, and keys whose -1 fallback differs from the default actually take effect.
//enableANGLE: 0 = off if unsupported, 1 = on if unsupported. Cobalt ships no ANGLE, so 0 either way; stated so the key is present and deliberate rather than absent and inherited.
//enableNoError: 0 = off, 1 = swallow errors partially, 2 = swallow all. 0. Partial-swallowing hides real driver errors behind a black screen, which is how the 26.3 shader failure stayed hard to read.
//enableExtComputeShader: Expose compute shaders. Off: a GL 4.x application may issue compute work the device cannot do, and the failure surfaces far from its cause.
//enableExtTimerQuery: Expose timer queries so Minecraft's frame-time graph works. Adreno 613 reports GL_EXT_disjoint_timer_query.
//enableExtDirectStateAccess: Expose DSA. 26.3 and every modern version call glBindVertexBuffer/glCreateVertexArrays directly; without it those dlsym to null.
//maxGlslCacheSize: Megabytes of translated-shader cache. 30 matches upstream's own default. 0 disables the cache entirely, which also disables the negative cache in patches/0001 -- a shader that fails to compile is recompiled on every resource reload. MC reloads resources on every dimension change.
//customGLVersion: 40 = GL 4.0 core, exposed as ES 3.2 to the application. This is what the device log shows the game receiving: '4.0.0 Cobalt 2.0.0'. Raising it makes MC request features the driver does not have.
//fsr1Setting: 0 = FSR 1 off. It is a post-process that needs its own shader program and render targets, and Cobalt does not wire it up.
//hideMGEnvLevel: 0 = renderer logging visible. Non-zero silences the log lines that make a driver problem diagnosable, which is the opposite of what was wanted.
multidrawOrder: native, multiindirect, multibasevertex, multiarrays, indirect, basevertex, unroll, compute
